column1: # game batch (evidence-backed subset): owner <TAB> kind <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Scope: com.desertstormfront.game methods whose meaning is pinned by an existing reader or by
# Direction: the private fields (i, j, k, l) are filled from the constructor tuple
#   (index, dx, dy, angle) - East(1,1,0,0), North(0,1,pi/2) ... - and e() returns
# TerrainType: the two rulesets construct it as (id, "Name[i18n]: Name", "KEY", 'code', spriteCount)
#   and ModRuleset reads exactly the json keys id/name/key/code/count, which fixes a=id, b=name,
#   c=key, d=code, e=spriteCount. TerrainTypeList then matches d() against a char and c() against a
# UnitTypeList: a(Domain) compares getDomain() -> hasDomain ; a() returns true when any type
#   canCapture() -> hasCapturingUnit (same name as the IntentGroup method it mirrors) ;
# Projectile: GameScreen only renders it when d() holds, reads e() as the Vec3 position and computes
#   (gameTime - c()) / ammoType.getFlightTime() -> c is the launch time ; b() re-zeroes everything
#   -> clear ; the private static a() is the factory -> create ; the setters follow the fields.
# DrawQueue/DrawQueueNode: an insertion-sorted singly linked list keyed on getSortValue(); the
#   node's four static synthetic accessors mirror DijkstraNode -> getNext/setNext/getValue/setValue ;
#   the queue's a() unlinks the head and recycles the node -> poll, a(Sortable) inserts in order
# EffectTimer: a() is the factory -> create, b() reads the remaining time -> getTime,
# Site: the private constructor takes (terrainType, index, Vec2) and the static factory forwards to
#   it -> of ; the accessors were already pinned by BuildingSpriteTable (d/e are the terrain type and
#   the variant index) and by UnitPosition handling (f is the position) -> getTerrainType /
# PositionedSortable / UnitSortProxy: d() returns the UnitPosition both classes exist to expose
# Unit: v() feeds UnitSpriteAnimation.getProgressRegion(isGuarding, v()) but must NOT be called
#   getProgress - Unit already has one for the production progress field, and the renamer's
#   collision check rejected exactly that name. The frames it selects are the movement/progress
#   variants, so the meaning overlaps "progress" without being the same value; it is left unnamed
#   until the caller's two progress concepts are told apart.
# Deliberately unnamed in this batch (no reader in the tree, or a meaning that needs a call-site
# study before it may be written down): Sortable.a()/b() (constant true/false per implementation),
# Unit's remaining single/double-letter accessors, UnitType.r()/E()/F(), AmmoType/BirdType members,
# the map-mode and player state accessors (mode.*, player.*, PlayerStatistics), MapTemplatePainter,
# UnitList.a(int), ProjectileList.a(). These stay obfuscated rather than guessed (see 25 s3).
